tasks.title: Announcement #55
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a university event.
tasks.transcript: The annual student art exhibition opens this Thursday at 3 PM in the University Gallery, featuring paintings and sculptures by our incredibly talented art students. It's opening a month earlier this year to accommodate the gallery renovation. New this year, you'll have the chance to talk with the artists, hear the stories behind their work, and gain insight into their creative journeys. Artists will be on site Fridays from 4 to 5 PM this week and next.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?

options.A: A daily conversation series about creativity
options.B: Changes to gallery hours during a renovation
options.C: Information about an annual art exhibition
options.D: How to sign up for a student art competition

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：The annual student art exhibition opens this Thursday at 3 PM in the University Gallery... 选项分析： A. A daily conversation series about creativity 关于创造力的每日对话系列。公告中提到可以跟艺术家交谈，但这不是每日系列，也不是主要内容，所以A选项错误。 B. Changes to gallery hours during a renovation 翻新期间画廊开放时间的变更。公告中提到展览比往年提前一个月开幕以适应翻新，但这不是主要内容，主要内容是展览本身的信息，所以B选项错误。 C. Information about an annual art exhibition 关于年度艺术展览的信息。公告围绕年度学生艺术展览的开幕时间、地点、展品、新增互动环节等内容展开，所以C选项正确。 D. How to sign up for a student art competition 如何报名参加学生艺术比赛。公告中未提及比赛报名，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What will featured artists do at the gallery?

options.A: Talk about the development of their art
options.C: Lead guided tours of the gallery
options.D: Create artwork in real time on site

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：参展艺术家将在画廊做什么？ 定位原文：New this year, you'll have the chance to talk with the artists, hear the stories behind their work, and gain insight into their creative journeys. Artists will be on site Fridays from 4 to 5 PM this week and next. 选项分析： A. Talk about the development of their art 谈论他们艺术的发展过程。公告中提到可以听作品背后的故事并了解他们的创作历程，这对应“艺术的发展”，所以A选项正确。 B. Facilitate a painting workshop 组织绘画工作坊。公告中未提及工作坊或教学，所以B选项错误。 C. Lead guided tours of the gallery 带领画廊导览。公告中未提及导览，所以C选项错误。 D. Create artwork in real time on site 在现场实时创作艺术作品。公告中只提到艺术家在场交谈，未提现场创作，所以D选项错误。
